# Redaction only — not a real GitHub clone.
# URL shape: x-access-token:token@host. Wrong token → 401 from git-authfail.
# useExecLogs=true; assert userinfo masked as ***@host and sentinel absent.

git-authfail-start

cp .apinfra.secret .apinfra

exec apinfra
stderr 'http://\*\*\*@'
! stderr 'ghp_TokAsPassword99'
stderr 'done duration='

! exec grep -R --exclude='.apinfra*' ghp_TokAsPassword99 $HOME

git-authfail-stop

-- .apinfra.secret --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
repo=http://x-access-token:ghp_TokAsPassword99@127.0.0.1:18081/repo
useExecLogs=true

-- .env --
